description: Expand your gaming storage with the Game Drive for PS5TM external hard drive. Officially licensed for PlayStation®, this HDD seamlessly integrates with PS5 and PS4TM consoles, adding an exciting flash of colour to any gaming environment with Blue LED lighting. Archive your PS5 games effortlessly on the drive until it’s time to transfer and play them. Enjoy a larger library without deleting titles with 2 TB of additional external hard drive storage.
